notes.title: The Level editor update is here!
notes.content: [h3][b]The very same editor we've used to create Train Valley Origin's campaign is now available![/b][/h3][p] [/p][list][*][p]Shape your design and choose from 4 special mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Garnish it with more than 500 decorative objects[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock 64 additional decorations as you play and earn XP[/p][/*][*][p]Publish levels and download other player's creations through the in-game browser - [b]we have prepared 17 brand new levels[/b] for you to try ([b]look for Grem19[/b]'s submissions) and get acquainted with the workshop while you do[/p][/*][*][p]Then head over to your Steam profile and get yourself a Train Valley Origins badge with all the Train Valley Origins Steam trading cards you've earned :)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]But that of course isn't all.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]We are hosting a level design contest with Steam wallet funds prizes:[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]You have[b] until 1st of September[/b] to devise a level and upload it[/p][/*][*][p][b]We will choose 5 winners[/b] at the end of the contest based on a weekly level roundup[/p][/*][*][p][b]There are no specific requirements except that your level should be completable :)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always please do not hesitate and contact us with any questions or suggestions. Now go, build a puzzle or five :)[/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://discord.com/invite/train-valley"][b]Discord[/b][/url][b]🖥️[url="https://twitter.com/trainvalley"]Twitter / X[/url] 🖥️[url="https://www.facebook.com/trainvalley/"]Facebook[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Train Valley Origins launches today!
notes.content:
[p]This one takes us back to where it all began. Packed with hand-crafted levels and set during the golden age of rail travel, it’s all about smart track building, tricky puzzles, and keeping your trains running without too many crashes. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451440/Train_Valley_Origins/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]👉 Here’s what’s in the game:[/p][list][*][p] 40 levels with different challenges[/p][/*][*][p] 24 unlockable locomotives, from steam classics to electric powerhouses[/p][/*][*][p] Simple, satisfying gameplay that rewards smart planning and controlled timing[/p][/*][*][p] Free built-in level editor coming with the first major update[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And now, introducing [b]Train Valley Canon[/b] collection:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55189/Train_Valley_Canon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Train Valley, Train Valley 2 and Train Valley Origins bundled up and ready to go.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, you can [b]grab Train Valley Origins in a bundle[/b] with our friends' games:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Idle Waters[/b] – cozy idle fishing game that waits for you at the bottom of your screen.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55057/Idle_Waters__Train_Valley_Origins/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Islands and Trains[/b] – relaxing sandbox about crafting tiny railway dioramas.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54923/I_Like_Trains/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Automate It[/b] – a factory-building puzzle game that challenges players to find clever solutions.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54916/Train_Automation/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you’ve played Train Valley before, we're glad to have you back. If you haven’t — welcome aboard! :)[/p][p]

[/p][h3][b][url="https://discord.com/invite/train-valley"]Discord[/url]🖥️[url="https://twitter.com/trainvalley"]Twitter / X[/url] 🖥️[url="https://www.facebook.com/trainvalley/"]Facebook[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Get ready to Think Inside The Box 📦
notes.content:
Do you love designing the ultimate factory while solving challenging puzzles? Automate It combines the satisfaction of optimization with level-based gameplay that will put your engineering skills to the test.

Your goal? Build the best-automated systems while optimizing for both space and power usage. Thousands of solutions exist — how efficient can you be?

Automate It Demo includes:

[list]
[*] 13 handcrafted levels designed to push your problem-solving and optimization skills to the limit.
[*] Weekly and Random challenges – it’s not just about making things work, but making them work better. Your solutions will be scored based on space and power usage.
[*] Global Leaderboard – optimize your solutions and compete with other players.
[*] Community Hub and Level Editor (demo version) – create your own challenges and share them with the community.
[*] 4 Achievements specifically designed for this Demo!
[*] Multiple ways to solve each challenge – there’s no single correct answer, so experiment and find the best approach!
[/list]

The main game will feature a full campaign with 50 unique scenarios, a Full Level Editor, and some other surprising goodies!

Check out the Automate It Demo 🏭
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2472770/Automate_It/
After you’ve played the demo, it would be amazing if you could take a moment to leave a review. Even a few words go a long way in helping indie devs get more visibility on Steam. Plus, they’d love to hear your thoughts and see what you think!
